subject: CoAll evolution-domain registry currentness
contradictions: The registry may intentionally remain coarse; absence of a relation family from evolution-lanes.json does not prove it needs a new top-level lane.
Adding every newly landed relation family as a lane would recreate ontology-by-folder and subscription explosion.
tests: Compare the exact evolution-lanes.json domain set against evolution-convergence-r1.json newly_landed_descendant_relations.
Reconcile open donor PRs 28, 34, 37 and 43 against current main before adding or renaming lanes.
For each candidate relation family, classify as EXISTING_LANE_SUBDOMAIN, ALIAS, CROSS_CUTTING_RELATION or NEW_LANE before registry mutation.
Require subscription-profile impact review so lane growth does not silently widen receiver context.
expected_benefit: Keep the routing registry current enough to avoid blind spots while preventing top-level lane proliferation and duplicate ontology roots.
wake_conditions: A receiver classifies the landed descendant relations against the current lane set.
A current-main reconciliation finds a genuinely unrepresented routing domain.
A subscription or routing failure is traced to registry coverage rather than receiver logic.
